name: Chikura Sayo
source:
Her real name is Chikura Sayo. She is a shy and quiet girl. She is timid and not good at sports, and is bullied. She is thin and her breasts are not that big.

She is called “Jizou” by the main character, who looks down on her. At first, she liked Ren, who did not discriminate against her because of her appearance.
